recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中兩個有核紅血球之間以細長染色質橋（internuclear bridging，箭頭）相連，另可見雙核有核紅血球與核低分葉、顆粒減少的嗜中性球，加上淚滴細胞，屬於多系發育不良的線索，符合 MDS 伴多系發育不良。
features: Panel A: two adjacent nucleated red cells with dense round nuclei connected by a thin chromatin bridge (arrow)
Panel B: binucleated nucleated red cell with two round dense nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm
Panel B: neutrophil with hypolobated, band-like nucleus and reduced granulation (pseudo-Pelger-Huet-like/hypogranular)
Panel B: nucleated red cell with irregular nuclear budding/bridging (arrow)
Red cell anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and an echinocyte
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows circulating nucleated red cells with dysplastic features, including internuclear chromatin bridging between two erythroid nuclei (A, arrow), a binucleated form and nuclear budding (B). A hypolobated, hypogranular neutrophil is also present, and red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes. Blasts are not seen in these fields. Findings are consistent with multilineage dysplasia, supporting myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia; bone marrow examination with blast count and cytogenetics is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia produces nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils rather than hypolobated hypogranular neutrophils, and corrects with B12/folate.
CDA I shows internuclear bridges confined to the erythroid lineage in a young patient without granulocytic dysplasia.
PMF shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with numerous teardrop cells and a fibrotic marrow, while dysplastic bridging is not a characteristic feature.

ddx.dx: Drug or toxin-induced dysplasia (e.g., chemotherapy, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Secondary dysplasia has an identifiable exposure or deficiency and resolves after its removal, typically with ring sideroblasts and vacuolated precursors in copper deficiency.
